subject.title: No owner role on an org I created

question: Does the creation audit confirm that jasonacurry created the xerg organization and should have the membership corrected to owner?
rationale: Only authorized production evidence can establish whether a role correction is legitimate and whether the incident reflects bad stored data or a still-active creation-path defect.

options.title: Audit and conditionally repair
options.body: Verify the creation event and identity, restore owner membership when they match, and open a focused regression fix if the creation path can still produce the wrong role.

options.title: Request identity evidence
options.body: Keep the role unchanged and request additional account or creation evidence if production provenance is incomplete or conflicting.

recommendation.title: Audit and conditionally repair
recommendation.body: Verify the creation event and identity, restore owner membership when they match, and open a focused regression fix if the creation path can still produce the wrong role.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision concerns a central publisher authorization boundary and production organization ownership.
